entries.a6a376b6559e32fb: A group consisting of NISSHIN GROUP HOLDINGS Company, Limited (headquarters: Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo) and 13 consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026). It operates real estate and real estate management businesses mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and a construction business nationwide. NDFactor Co., Ltd., an other affiliate, holds 35.2% of the company's shares.
entries.ad4e38d7f53c85e0: It sets out “Trust, nurture capable people, create a rich living environment through business activities and contribute to society” as its shared philosophy, and states that it aims to develop the group as a “comprehensive real estate and construction business” that provides, in addition to “ease of living,” composite value such as asset building for residents and the creation of stable investment targets for investors. Priority issues to address are securing and developing human resources; enlarging development projects for the stable supply of self-developed condominiums and acquiring land aimed at sales two to three years ahead; financial strategy for real estate development; developing the investor market using development capabilities; securing profitability through selective ordering of high-margin construction work; and expanding the number of condominium buildings and units under management and the related revenue opportunities.
